title: Golden selection for renemarc
description: Hand-picked paths from Rene-Marc Simard's configuration, each carrying the artifact class it is expected to receive. The class is what makes an entry a check rather than a line of a list: a path alone says only that something was selected, while a path with its class fails both when the path stops being selected and when it is selected as the wrong thing. It is not exhaustive over the corpus -- the inventory is that -- and deliberately so: a file listing every selected path would be a copy of the inventory that nobody reads, where these entries are chosen so that an exclude rule broad enough to swallow a directory takes one of them with it.

repo.description: The repository's owner handle, repeated here from the filename so that the two can be checked against each other: a file whose entries describe one repo while sitting under another's name is the kind of copy-paste error nothing else in the project would catch.

entries.description: At least one pinned path, because a golden file with no entries guards nothing.

artifactClass.description: The closed set, repeated from the `reference-catalog` spec. `other` is admitted as a value but is not admissible as a pin: the class-pinning requirement excludes it, because it is defined as the residual a file falls into when no other class fits, and pinning it would commit the corpus to keeping a file whose only justification is that we could not classify it.

path.description: Repo-relative, exactly as `git ls-files` reports it.
